historical_references.reference: Adiyak was a title given to the head of the Jain monastic order known as Digambaras, who were established around the 6th century CE in India.
Adiyak also refers to the first or founder of a temple or institution in Tamil Nadu, South India, and is a title of respect for the person who establishes and manages the temple.

While it was traditionally used in feudal Indian societies to denote a position of respect and service, its modern context has expanded to various fields. In the South Indian Culture context, 'Adiyak' can refer to a title for elders or respected figures within a community. In the Tech Industry, 'Adiyak' can be used as a title for a senior or founding member of a startup or tech team. In the Startups scene, it's also seen as a playful term for the first employee of a newly established company. Platforms like LinkedIn, Facebook, and Twitter are popular forums where 'Adiyak' can be used in professional and casual contexts, reflecting the trend of blending traditional values with modern adaptations.
